10 documented facts from official government data. Consistently underreported. The gap between reality and coverage is the media capture in action.

Health Canada's 6th Annual Report (Dec 2024) confirmed 76,475 deaths. At 45.2/day, the estimated total today exceeds 97,000. The government has not published an update. Media rarely reports the running total or the decision to stop publishing.

Each MAID death saves the healthcare system $8,150 and reduces demand for long-term care facilities — the facilities Brookfield owns. This conflict of interest is documented in Ethics Commissioner filings. Media covers Carney's career but rarely connects the financial interest to the MAID program.

The AG, Ethics Commissioner, RCMP, Information Commissioner, Privacy Commissioner — all can investigate. None have produced meaningful enforcement outcomes against the government. Media reports individual findings but never compiles the pattern of zero enforcement.

6.5 million Canadians lack a family doctor. Express Entry selects thousands of foreign-trained physicians. Provincial credential barriers block 70%+ from practicing. Media covers the doctor shortage and immigration separately — never connecting them.

Paid from wage earners (53% marginal rate) to bondholders (pension funds, banks). The $78.3B deficit adds to the principal every year. Media reports the deficit number but rarely explains who receives the interest payments or the fiscal loop it creates.

The Pearce Study (Western University, OMEGA Journal, Feb 2025) explicitly calculates cost savings from extending MAID to chronic condition patients. This is published academic research — not conspiracy theory. Media has not reported on this study.

CPPIB, PSP, OTPP, Caisse — $2T+ invested in housing, healthcare, infrastructure. Your retirement depends on rising property values (opposing housing affordability) and healthcare investments (benefiting from privatization). Media never explains this structural capture.

Crown immunity means the government that wasted $2.4B on Phoenix, $59M on ArriveCAN, and killed 97,764 through MAID faces no financial liability. Media reports individual scandals but never explains why no one is ever held accountable — Crown immunity is the legal answer.

COVID showed what happens when supply is cut. The lesson was not learned. Media covered PPE shortages during COVID but has not connected pharmaceutical API dependence to the ongoing healthcare vulnerability.

MAID 0→97K, debt doubled, housing 8x income, 6.5M without doctor, military collapsed. Only boil water advisories improved — and 28 remain after $8.2B spent. Media covers individual issues but never compiles the decade-long pattern of comprehensive decline.
Individual facts are reported. The connections between them are not. $1.4B CBC funding + captured CRTC + 3 companies = structural inability to compile the picture.
